events.title: Open-weight models and sovereign AI, a Compute Connect Fireside Chat
events.description: Who this is for ML and inference engineers, heads of compute and AI infrastructure leads at AI labs and teams running training or inference at scale. GPU and data center operators, compute buyers and capacity partners are part of the same conversation. The conversation What does sovereignty in AI really mean, and does it mean the same thing in San Francisco, Brussels and Beijing? Where should teams insist on control in their stack, from the GPUs to model serving, and what's a distraction? When does running your own open-weight model beat calling an API? And as open-weight adoption takes off, what is the next source of lock-in? Our guest panelists NIKTA KHANI is Head of Compute Deals at San Francisco Compute, where she leads SFC's global GPU supply procurement, serving leading neolabs, technology companies, and governments. Previously, Nikta was a geopolitical risk consultant to leading technology companies navigating U.S.-China and U.S.-Middle East relations. Nikta was a GTM lead at Z.AI while living in Beijing, China. Nikta spent several years as an advisor to the U.S. Congress, including to the Senate Homeland Security Committee. Nikta was a Schwarzman Scholar at Tsinghua University where she received a Master's in Business. Nikta is also a writer, with essays published in I-D Magazine and other publications. UMAR ARSHAD is Minister for the Future at Provocative, where he helps expand its data center footprint and bring GPU compute online for AI customers. Previously, he led AI inference and model serving at Capital One across enterprise GenAI and ML platforms serving more than 80% of the company's AI/ML models, from open-weight LLMs to fraud and underwriting models. His experience spans the full stack of AI sovereignty: compute, inference, and governance. ANDREAS BLOOMQUIST spent more than nine years building infrastructure and observability products at Amazon and AWS. He launched CloudWatch Application Signals, AWS's native application performance monitoring service, and led the launch of Amazon's central GPU orchestration service, which centralized GPU access and improved utilization across Amazon's science and AI teams. He co-founded Chamber, which builds MLOps agents to monitor and self-heal GPU workloads. Moderated by RYAN MILLER, Head of Marketing at Impossible Cloud. Please note We expect a full house. Entry is first come, first served, even with an approved ticket, so please arrive early. No plus ones can be accommodated, and everyone needs their own approved ticket. The evening 6:00pm: Doors open, drinks, and networking. 6:30pm: Fireside chat and open discussion with audience. 8:00pm: Food, drinks + networking with fellow compute buyers/sellers. 9:00pm: Event ends. Presented by Impossible Cloud is a neocloud for sovereign enterprise inference: bare metal GPUs, object storage, and serverless inference in early access.

events.title: Nightshift
events.description: Nightshift brings you two rooms of the best dark alternative music including Darkwave, Goth, Industrial, Synth, Dark 80's, Electro, Post-Punk and more. In the front room we bring you the best classic Goth and Industrial favorites from a catalog of music that spans over 30 years. In the back room dance to the latest music from the Darkwave, Electro, Synth and Minimalist scenes. Hosted by resident DJs Melting Girl, Daniel Skellington, Owen and Starr Noir. there all night! —— 9:30pm-2am $10 Cover (more info)

events.title: Salsa Night with Live Band: Somos El Son
events.description: Join us for an evening filled with vibrant music and a fantastic atmosphere, dancing to the tunes of Somos El Son. Whether you're a seasoned dancer or just looking to have a blast, our Live Salsa Night guarantees an unforgettable experience! Come in early and enjoy the many pleasures available at the Cigar Bar: Pan-Latin cuisine, craft cocktails, and fine cigars. There is a $20 charge beginning at 9:00 PM. Live music starts at 9:30 PM. If your party is arriving before 9:00 PM, there is no need to purchase tickets online. Salsa lessons with Ava & Rodolfo begin at 7:00 PM and are paid separately: $14 in advance or $20 at the door. NO REFUNDS - Must be 21+
